liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): Features strong jamming; Reviewer finds it decent [12][20]
- **Good Lovin'** (1 review): Reviewer calls it awesome [18]
- **Big River** (1 review): Jammed out thrillingly, with nice keyboard work [23]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Contains some very nice Jerry guitar solos [12]
- **The Other One** (1 review): The transition from Drums into The Other One is described as killer [22]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-04-06.147759.sbd.betty.dalton.miller.sirmick.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 161 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Static in Set II was reduced but remains noticeable [1]
- **gd1978-04-06.mtx.miller.wagner.81508.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 166 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1978-04-06.140694.sbd.pcm.miller.sirmick.flac1644**: soundboard; 19 songs; 161 min [4]. Said about its sound: Tape age caused small dropouts and digital noise, patched using shnid 81307 [4]
- **gd1978-04-06.148068.sony.54p.wagner.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 19 songs; 168 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [5]
- **gd1978-04-06.sbd.miller.81307.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 159 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [9]. Said about its sound: Soundboard quality described as impeccable; Sound is great apart from an audience-recording patch in Bertha [18][19]
- **gd78-04-06.sbd.unknown.290.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 151 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [10]. Said about its sound: Soundboard recording sounds superb to this listener; Reviewer calls the soundboard sound superb [12][15]

## Around the show

- Attendee recalls Jerry seeming tired, distracted and fed up, making faces and gesturing, with low energy onstage [16]
- Arena was about half full, and tickets cost $6.50; the band returned to the hall later that year [16]
- Reviewer places this show above the rest of the 1978 shows, calling it another gem from that year [15]
- Attendee considered it the worst of the roughly 50 shows seen up to then, though it has held up well [16]
- This show and the next night are slower, less refined moments of spring 1978; April 8 is considered phenomenal [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-04-06.147759.sbd.betty.dalton.miller.sirmick.flac16**: taped by Betty Cantor;Tim Dalton; transferred by Sirmick and Charlie Miller; source: SBD Master Reel (7" two track @ 7 1/2 ips - recorded by Betty Cantor) > PCM501ES @ 44.055 kHz > DAT (44k) - From the Tim Dalton collection. [1]. Also: Bertha was patched in from another source (shnid 19510) provided by Bob Wagner and David Minches; A tape flip in The Other One was patched from shnid 140694; Tim supplied the source and Charlie did the transfer [1]
- **gd1978-04-06.mtx.miller.wagner.81508.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Kevin Tobin;Charlie Miller;David Minches; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 2 Source Mix (65%-SBD/35%-AUD) [2]. Also: Soundboard and audience sources were aligned and synced in Audition 2.0, originally for a DTS CD, matrix and audio DVD; The matrix mix was made by an archive.org user [2]
- **gd1978-04-06.140694.sbd.pcm.miller.sirmick.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick; source: Source: sbd > master reel > pcm; Transfer: Sony SL-10 > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 > wav 16/44.1; Lineage: wav > Adobe… [4]. Also: Bertha was patched in wholesale from another source, courtesy of Bob Wagner and David Minches [4]
- **gd1978-04-06.148068.sony.54p.wagner.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Bob Wagner; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Bob Wagner's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony 54P mics > Sony TC-158 (Maxell UDXLII-C90) [5]. Also: A 14-second patch in Drums comes from the shnid 140694 soundboard source [5]
- **gd1978-04-06.sbd.miller.81307.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> PCM -> Dat D [9]
- **gd78-04-06.sbd.unknown.290.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [10]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1978-04-06 Curtis Hixon Convention Hall, Tampa, FL, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1978-04-06-curtis-hixon-convention-hall-tampa-fl-usa/) [25]
